name: @lumi/forest-design
description: LUMI Forest: renderer-neutral vector scene, characters, procedural worlds, accessible RN UI and motion system

scripts.test:visual: npm run export:svg && python3 tools/visual-regression.py verify
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run api:check && npm run test:device-parser && npm run test:visual && npm run test:characters:visual && npm run test:procedural:visual && npm run test:motion:visual
scripts.visual:approve: npm run export:svg && python3 tools/visual-regression.py approve
scripts.test:characters:visual: npm run export:characters && python3 tools/characters-visual-regression.py verify
scripts.characters:visual:approve: npm run export:characters && python3 tools/characters-visual-regression.py approve
scripts.test:procedural:visual: npm run export:procedural && python3 tools/procedural-visual-regression.py verify
scripts.procedural:visual:approve: npm run export:procedural && python3 tools/procedural-visual-regression.py approve
scripts.test:motion:visual: npm run export:motion && python3 tools/motion-visual-regression.py verify
scripts.motion:visual:approve: npm run export:motion && python3 tools/motion-visual-regression.py approve
scripts.test:versioning: npm run typecheck:core && node --test tests/versioning.test.cjs tests/release-evidence.test.cjs
scripts.release:verify-device: npm run typecheck:core && node tools/device/verify-release-evidence.cjs release-evidence/manifest.json
scripts.release:pack: npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run api:check && npm run release:verify-package && npm run release:smoke-core && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
